steps.arguments:
argument :user, result(:validate_user)
    argument :amount, input(:amount)
    argument :card_token, input(:card_token)
steps.compensateBody:
fn _reason, %{amount: amount, card_token: card_token}, _context ->
      GgenIgniter.Reactors.Examples.Support.refund(card_token, amount)
      :ok
    end
steps.name: charge_payment
steps.runBody:
fn %{user: user, amount: amount, card_token: card_token}, _context ->
      GgenIgniter.Reactors.Examples.Support.charge(user, amount, card_token)
    end

steps.body:
switch :route_by_amount do
    on input(:amount)

    matches? &(&1 > 1000) do
      return :flag_large

      step :flag_large do
        run fn _args, _context -> {:ok, :large} end
      end
    end

    default do
      return :flag_normal

      step :flag_normal do
        run fn _args, _context -> {:ok, :normal} end
      end
    end
  end

map :notify_admins do
    source value(["ops@example.com", "audit@example.com"])
    batch_size 2
    allow_async? true

    step :notify do
      argument :email, element(:notify_admins)
      run fn %{email: email}, _context -> {:ok, "notified #{email}"} end
    end
  end

collect :summary do
    argument :user, result(:validate_user)
    argument :charge, result(:charge_payment)
    argument :notified, result(:notify_admins)

    transform fn inputs -> %{user: inputs.user, charge: inputs.charge, notified: inputs.notified} end
  end

steps.guardBody:
fn %{user: user}, _context ->
      if is_nil(user) do
        {:halt, {:error, :no_user}}
      else
        :cont
      end
    end
steps.name: validate_user
steps.runBody:
fn %{user: user}, _context ->
      if user.active? do
        {:ok, user}
      else
        {:error, :inactive_user}
      end
    end

steps.body:
debug :log_charge do
    argument :charge, result(:charge_payment)
    argument :message, value("charge completed")
  end

steps.name: send_receipt
steps.runBody:
fn %{user: user, charge: charge}, _context ->
      GgenIgniter.Reactors.Examples.Support.send_receipt(user, charge)
    end

steps.body:
group :audit_group do
    argument :charge, result(:charge_payment)
    before_all &GgenIgniter.Reactors.Examples.Support.audit_before/3
    after_all &GgenIgniter.Reactors.Examples.Support.audit_after/1

    step :record_audit do
      argument :charge, input(:charge)
      run fn %{charge: charge}, _context ->
        {:ok, "audited #{charge.amount}"}
      end
    end
  end

steps.name: fetch_user

steps.body:
around :with_logging, &GgenIgniter.Reactors.Examples.Support.with_logging/4 do
    step :logged_step do
      run fn _args, _context -> {:ok, :done} end
    end
  end

template :welcome_message do
    argument :user, result(:validate_user)

    template """
    Welcome <%= @user.email %>!
    """
  end
